findings.issue: No explicit trigger phrase in the description.
findings.current_text: Formats reports and cleans up data.
findings.suggested_rewrite: Formats and cleans up reports. Use this any time the user has a report that needs formatting or cleanup.
findings.why_it_matters: Under-triggering means the skill silently never gets used for cases it should cover.

findings.issue: No 'When NOT to Use' section, and the body skips straight to numbered steps with no framing.
findings.suggested_rewrite: Add a short Purpose paragraph and a 'When NOT to Use' section before the numbered steps.
findings.why_it_matters: Without framing, Claude has to infer scope from the steps alone, which invites overreach into adjacent tasks.

summary: A third, independent read of example-skill: agrees on the triggering gap, rates the missing 'When NOT to Use' section more severely than the other two passes, and didn't flag the writing-style or credential-handling issues the earlier runs raised.
